senses.def: A Usenet control message indicating that a newsgroup should be removed.
ex: Every Usenet groups, and all its associated problems, will have been wiped off the face of the Earth forever by the might of the rmgroup.

senses.def: To remove (a newsgroup) or attempt to do so by means of such a message.
ex: Of course, to prevent any power-crazed maniacs from putting the groups back, the newsgroup `control' will be rmgrouped.
